Refreshed the root `uv.lock` and the public-mirror overlay lock (`mirror/overlay/uv.lock`) for `mngr_forward`'s newly explicit `starlette` dependency (previously only transitive via fastapi), which backs the `starlette.types.Send` import used by the forward proxy's stall-guarded streaming response.

Stopped `test_every_project_with_tests_has_coverage_config` timing out on the offload sandboxes. Its `_has_test_files` helper enumerated every test file under each project rather than stopping at the first, so it walked `apps/minds`'s gitignored subtrees -- node_modules and the frontend build -- in full, which was most of the test's runtime and enough to exceed its 10-second budget on a sandbox. The walk now short-circuits on the first match, with identical results for every project.
